name: Summer Youth Employment Program
org: Pima County Community and Workforce Development
what_you_do: Work a paid summer internship at a Pima County site, learn new skills and attend summer school.
who_can_apply: Youth ages 14 to 21. The page lists no other rules.
duration: Two 2026 sessions: June 1 to June 26, or July 6 to July 31
deadline_text: 2026 applications ran Feb 2 to Feb 27, 2026 at 5 p.m. and are closed. 2027 dates not posted.
how_to_apply: Apply online at summeryouth.pima.gov. Or pick up a paper form at high schools and community centers in Pima County.
notes: Expect applications to open again in early 2027 (last year it was February). Check the page in January.
